An IV for a hangover ` [Highlight start] delivers fluids, electrolytes, vitamins, and sometimes anti-nausea or pain medications directly into your bloodstream to rehydrate you and ease symptoms [Highlight end] ` , though it does not cure a hangover or speed up alcohol clearance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1zpULvWX00LzdXSWpEUW7vyM-cKfTF2S_cZp3ap_xl8ogGgh2plnAwaUeG-s50kmed5dsPKZPJzmJST5Cnu13q_KL1tH1zEXPuNzAFwGDFbNaE1IbFCYAVvTwwkyULW_D-g1kKDHh4y50i5SlFIp6uw_DY9mPvfktLAvJwuYXeNG)

### What It Does—and Doesn't Do

- **Faster rehydration:** Bypassing the stomach helps restore fluids and electrolytes quickly, which is especially useful if vomiting or severe nausea keeps you from drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF10AggRyK294vT9y6bonQFTbIMk5JtZb9NOTVR8ZoilD522YBhiGSWNrNIncucVzGP7180esMxJ5LE-NMuXUtC_I1sDbFcpOn7R3G-Y8iqZV5G4bmE1j30ofsujKoc9Zq-hlmTxG0MQ8iTHeIupdVnQt_Ju_1iPd8jLmhK205yBjHFAWujSy8NYUyUg)
- **Symptom relief, not a cure:** Hangovers also involve inflammation, sleep disruption, and toxic alcohol byproducts like acetaldehyde. IVs do not speed up how fast your liver processes alcohol, and fatigue or brain fog may linger.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF10AggRyK294vT9y6bonQFTbIMk5JtZb9NOTVR8ZoilD522YBhiGSWNrNIncucVzGP7180esMxJ5LE-NMuXUtC_I1sDbFcpOn7R3G-Y8iqZV5G4bmE1j30ofsujKoc9Zq-hlmTxG0MQ8iTHeIupdVnQt_Ju_1iPd8jLmhK205yBjHFAWujSy8NYUyUg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX1uFbxXfST8plNJhrDNgDBuLGBl81yHQELTOS7_Gp6ichdXlLfzzwK_Ot1wD0hYn2GGKbFxToUhaCMjdJRCf0cbZF7ftkXWew2mnv8duoU2amEmqclPAukGJeGUDVhTrzA3fmiuzC-AezjA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)
- **Oral fluids often work well:** Drinking water, broth, or electrolyte solutions is usually enough if you can keep liquids down.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)

### Common Ingredients and Costs

- **Typical contents:** Saline or electrolyte fluids, B vitamins, and optional add-ons like anti-nausea medication, pain relievers, magnesium, or glutathione.
- **Typical cost:** Clinics and mobile IV services often charge roughly $150 to $250+ depending on add-ons and location.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXxPfQ33ZCxJmbwGT4mnhbQOQYDqCoclQD5LYfUxq1-u8fbLAkNb0My_QWkYO0kG2HSERUgaQJS_7XXc0RIX9TRx-7ncwh3xbatAoG9bqPPyuYPNxte9bwuYUYqwlYfMrT7ujgFdI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF10AggRyK294vT9y6bonQFTbIMk5JtZb9NOTVR8ZoilD522YBhiGSWNrNIncucVzGP7180esMxJ5LE-NMuXUtC_I1sDbFcpOn7R3G-Y8iqZV5G4bmE1j30ofsujKoc9Zq-hlmTxG0MQ8iTHeIupdVnQt_Ju_1iPd8jLmhK205yBjHFAWujSy8NYUyUg)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7622084941933676199&ibp=oshop)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:13130044896391034543&ibp=oshop)

### Risks and When to Seek Medical Care

- **Procedure and health risks:** IVs carry risks of pain, bruising, vein irritation, or infection. Fluid overload or electrolyte shifts can be dangerous for people with heart, kidney, or certain other medical conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1zpULvWX00LzdXSWpEUW7vyM-cKfTF2S_cZp3ap_xl8ogGgh2plnAwaUeG-s50kmed5dsPKZPJzmJST5Cnu13q_KL1tH1zEXPuNzAFwGDFbNaE1IbFCYAVvTwwkyULW_D-g1kKDHh4y50i5SlFIp6uw_DY9mPvfktLAvJwuYXeNG)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF10AggRyK294vT9y6bonQFTbIMk5JtZb9NOTVR8ZoilD522YBhiGSWNrNIncucVzGP7180esMxJ5LE-NMuXUtC_I1sDbFcpOn7R3G-Y8iqZV5G4bmE1j30ofsujKoc9Zq-hlmTxG0MQ8iTHeIupdVnQt_Ju_1iPd8jLmhK205yBjHFAWujSy8NYUyUg)
- **Medical evaluation:** Clinics and IV lounges are not a substitute for medical care. Seek prompt medical attention for severe or persistent vomiting, confusion, chest pain, trouble breathing, or signs of severe dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)

For more details on effectiveness and limitations, see [University of Rochester Medicine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA) and [Hackensack Meridian Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF1x_YmMnfwn_giNZvtHyZCh7KecFiBGi_0TQCNhpJglGXVn5G_vdF10GylyRmSEakXgCLb6Wd3xeWSWVGPyCKjQi5cbjP42CudA_plJmPsvgqhXcvRp13Gaoiu6D3oOJJhPqFEaLE-XW1SFddpcvpQvoC2HlICRbYAcrwkiFPrULidmt-FLAieyBFYa4IJTUQYQe97RAkMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1ydVAgQnlrj-nmPjcY0Sx8-j_-HsnvixLwsFrNPKAx3VejDkqGDdC8KqLGIRGzarKOdNNFzshvBcyilWVPguQ5eOh0ubItNOFmfmZPTDQDDaZ_q1RfEYui9Xyjvrhs-0IRLHmO1-tnwgoOElS2XqUivENC-s8oLzr7ofuqV4rdWGFWI0zB4tgU8mpnZtltB_324JWQU6mPuMtzJB)If you'd like to explore this further, share a bit of context:

items.title: Risks and When to Seek Medical Care
items.text: Procedure and health risks: IVs carry risks of pain, bruising, vein irritation, or infection. Fluid overload or electrolyte shifts can be dangerous for people with heart, kidney, or certain other medical conditions. Medical evaluation: Clinics and IV lounges are not a substitute for medical care. Seek prompt medical attention for severe or persistent vomiting, confusion, chest pain, trouble breathing, or signs of severe dehydration.
